0.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_000_000
0.description: Well met! I am Scanningway, data analyst for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Should you choose to join us, I would welcome your support.
0.translation_description: Ben trovato! Sono Scanningway, analista dei dati per l’Iniziativa di Esplorazione Cosmica. Se deciderai di unirti a noi, apprezzerò il tuo aiuto.

1.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_000
1.description: Well met! I am Scanningway, data analyst for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.
1.translation_description: Ben trovato! Sono Scanningway, analista dei dati per l’Iniziativa di Esplorazione Cosmica.

2.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_010
2.description: My duty is to record the efforts of each member and tally them up at regular intervals.
2.translation_description: Il mio compito è registrare l’impegno di ogni membro e calcolarne periodicamente il totale.

3.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_020
3.description: Not only does this data improve the efficiency of the initiative as a whole, but it highlights the individuals whose achievements are worthy of a reward.
3.translation_description: Questi dati non solo migliorano l’efficienza dell’Iniziativa nel suo complesso, ma mettono in luce chi merita un riconoscimento per i propri risultati.

4.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_030
4.description: Members with the highest metrics within a given period are given the vaunted title of “Star Contributor.”
4.translation_description: I membri con i risultati migliori in un determinato periodo ricevono l’ambito titolo di «Star Contributor».

5.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_035
5.description: As a token of our appreciation, anyone recognized as such shall have their name displayed prominently for all to see!
5.translation_description: Per ringraziarli del loro impegno, i loro nomi saranno messi in bella mostra, così che tutti possano vederli!

6.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_040
6.description: If you should have any questions, I recommend that you consult your exotablet.
6.translation_description: Se hai domande, ti consiglio di consultare il tuo esotablet.

7.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_200_000
7.description: Thank you for your contributions to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, but I'm afraid your metrics are not being recorded at this time.
7.translation_description: Grazie per il tuo contributo all’Iniziativa di Esplorazione Cosmica, ma al momento non sto registrando i tuoi risultati.

8.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_000
8.description: Thank you for your contributions to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative! Rest assured I have been recording everyone's metrics for the current data collection period.
8.translation_description: Grazie per il tuo contributo all’Iniziativa di Esplorazione Cosmica! Puoi stare tranquillo: in questo periodo sto registrando i risultati di tutti.

13.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_010
13.description: My apologies. I am not currently recording any metrics, so I'm afraid I have nothing to offer you.
13.translation_description: Mi dispiace. Al momento non sto registrando i risultati di nessuno, quindi non ho informazioni da darti.

14.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_020
14.description: Let me just pull up your latest metrics for the current data collection period... Ah, here we are!
14.translation_description: Vediamo i tuoi risultati più recenti per questo periodo... Ah, eccoli!

15.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_030
15.description: At present, you have reached...the top ten percent!? That's astounding! You just might be one of our Star Contributors this period!
15.translation_description: Al momento sei... tra il 10% migliore!? Incredibile! Potresti diventare uno Star Contributor questo periodo!

16.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_040
16.description: At present, you have reached...the top twenty percent! Keep it up, and the title of “Star Contributor” could be yours this period!
16.translation_description: Al momento sei... tra il 20% migliore! Continua così e potresti ottenere il titolo di «Star Contributor» questo periodo!

17.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_050
17.description: At present, you have reached...the top thirty percent. An impressive achievement!
17.translation_description: Al momento sei... tra il 30% migliore. Un risultato notevole!

18.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_060
18.description: At present, you have reached...the top fifty percent. You can do better than average, surely! Keep at it!
18.translation_description: Al momento sei... tra il 50% migliore. Puoi fare meglio della media, no? Continua così!

19.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_070
19.description: At present, you have reached... Well, your name has been recorded, if nothing else. Take your time!
19.translation_description: Al momento sei... Be’, almeno il tuo nome è registrato. Non avere fretta!

20.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_080
20.description: It appears I have no record of your achievements this period. Now's the time to get started!
20.translation_description: A quanto pare, non ho registrato alcun tuo risultato per questo periodo. È ora di cominciare!

21.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_090
21.description: Well, well, if it isn't Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in the flesh! On behalf of the initiative, thank you for all your hard work!
21.translation_description: Ma guarda un po’ chi si vede, Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in persona! A nome dell’Iniziativa, grazie per tutto il tuo impegno!

22.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_100
22.description: Well, well, if it isn't Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in the flesh!
22.translation_description: Ma guarda un po’ chi si vede, Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in persona!

23.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_110
23.description: As of this data collection period, you are once again eligible to earn the title. Let that serve as motivation for even greater contributions, hmmm?
23.translation_description: Da questo periodo puoi nuovamente ottenere il titolo. Che sia uno stimolo a dare un contributo ancora maggiore, eh?

24.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_120
24.description: Now, where were we...? Ah, yes, your latest metrics!
24.translation_description: Dove eravamo rimasti...? Ah, sì, i tuoi risultati più recenti!

25.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SYSTEM_300_010
25.description: Upon selection, Star Contributors cannot be reselected for fourteen days.
25.translation_description: Dopo la selezione, non è possibile selezionare nuovamente gli Star Contributor per 14 giorni.

27.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_400_000
27.description: My duty is to record the efforts of each member. Not only does this data improve the efficiency of the initiative as a whole, but it highlights the individuals whose achievements are worthy of a reward.
27.translation_description: Il mio compito è registrare l’impegno di ogni membro. Questi dati non solo migliorano l’efficienza dell’Iniziativa nel suo complesso, ma mettono in luce chi merita un riconoscimento per i propri risultati.

28.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_400_010
28.description: Members with the highest metrics within a given period are given the vaunted title of “Star Contributor.” Work hard, and you just might be one of them someday!
28.translation_description: I membri con i risultati migliori in un determinato periodo ricevono l’ambito titolo di «Star Contributor». Impegnati al massimo: un giorno potresti diventarlo anche tu!

29.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_400_020
29.description: If you should have any questions, I recommend that you consult your exotablet.
29.translation_description: Se hai domande, ti consiglio di consultare il tuo esotablet.
